apps/api/prisma/seed.js.description: Database seed script for local development and testing. Populates the database with demo users, workspaces, goals, action items, announcements, and activity logs. Uses @team-hub/shared constants for consistency.

apps/api/prisma/migrations/2026050100000.description: SQL migration adding 'iconUrl' and 'createdById' to Workspaces, and creating the 'Invitation' table for workspace onboarding.

apps/api/prisma/migrations/2026050110000.description: SQL migration adding operational fields: 'createdById' to Goals, 'dueDate'/'completedAt' to Milestones, 'pinnedAt' to Announcements, 'mentionedUserIds' to Comments, and 'entityType'/'entityId' to Activity/Notification logs.

apps/api/src/index.js.description: API server entry point. Configures Express, CORS, Socket.io, and mounts all major route groups (auth, workspaces, goals, announcements, action items, notifications).

apps/api/src/config/swagger.js.description: Swagger/OpenAPI configuration. Defines the API spec, security schemes (cookie-auth), and shared component schemas (User, Workspace, Goal, etc.).

apps/api/src/controllers/actionItems.js.description: Controller for Action Items (Kanban tasks). Handles CRUD, reordering (positioning), assignment notifications, and workspace-wide socket broadcasts.

apps/api/src/controllers/analytics.js.description: Controller for workspace analytics. Aggregates goal statuses, weekly action item completion, and monthly performance trends.

apps/api/src/controllers/announcements.j.description: Controller for Announcements. Supports rich-text sanitization, @mentions extraction, pinning, and real-time updates.

apps/api/src/controllers/audit.js.description: Controller for the Workspace Audit Log. Provides paginated activity streams with filtering by type, actor, and date range.

apps/api/src/controllers/comments.js.description: Controller for Announcement comments. Handles @mentions, capability-based deletion (own vs any), and notification dispatch.

apps/api/src/controllers/exports.js.description: Controller for data exports. Streams Goals, Action Items, Announcements, and Audit Logs as CSV files.

apps/api/src/controllers/goals.js.description: Controller for high-level Goals. Manages status transitions, ownership, and activity logging.

apps/api/src/controllers/invitations.js.description: Controller for Workspace invitations. Handles token generation, email dispatch via SMTP, and the public acceptance flow.

apps/api/src/controllers/members.js.description: Controller for Workspace membership. Manages roles, member removal, and ensures 'last admin' protection.

apps/api/src/controllers/milestones.js.description: Controller for Goal milestones. Tracks progress (0-100%) and updates completion timestamps.

apps/api/src/controllers/notifications.j.description: Controller for User notifications. Manages read/unread states and fetching the latest activity alerts.

apps/api/src/controllers/reactions.js.description: Controller for Announcement reactions (emojis). Toggles reactions and broadcasts changes via Socket.io.

apps/api/src/controllers/workspaces.js.description: Controller for Workspace management. Handles CRUD, icon uploads via Cloudinary, and hex color validation.

apps/api/src/lib/activity.js.description: Library for logging immutable activity feed entries. Designed to run within database transactions.

apps/api/src/lib/cloudinary.js.description: Integration with Cloudinary for image storage. Supports buffer-based uploads and publicId-based deletion.

apps/api/src/lib/csv.js.description: Library for streaming database results to CSV format using csv-stringify.

apps/api/src/lib/email.js.description: SMTP email client using Nodemailer. Supports fallback to console logging for development and rich templates for invitations and mentions.
